import os
from bioblend.galaxy import GalaxyInstance

api_key = open("/run/secrets/galaxy_api_key").read().strip()
gi = GalaxyInstance("https://usegalaxy.org", api_key)

# Copy the seed history
seed_id = "bbd44e69cb8906b55c85ef0589c72f82"
print(f"Copying history {seed_id}...")
new_history = gi.histories.copy_history(seed_id, name="ENO1 fold change analysis")
new_hist_id = new_history["id"]
print(f"New history ID: {new_hist_id}")
print(f"New history name: {new_history['name']}")

# List datasets in the new history
contents = gi.histories.show_history(new_hist_id, contents=True)
for item in contents:
    print(f"  ID: {item['id']}, Name: {item.get('name')}, Ext: {item.get('extension')}, State: {item.get('state')}")
PYEOF
